title: Origin story: Gilgamesh
description: Gilgamesh was the historical king of Uruk, two-thirds god and one-third man, whose tyranny drove the gods to create Enkidu as his rival. The two became inseparable friends, slew Humbaba and the Bull of Heaven together, and when Enkidu died, Gilgamesh crossed the world seeking immortality — returning with wisdom instead.

title: Cultural impact: Gilgamesh
description: The oldest written story; the first hero to learn that wisdom outlasts life.
